title: Price Basis Schedule for Denied Test-Strip Units, by Notice Form
content:
Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program — the price of one unit in a non-covered item patient charge on a denied test-strip claim.

**Schedule.** The price of a unit is, on a tier whose notice form is the CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice when the denied claim carries remittances whose allowed amounts total more than 0 and the treatment-class allowance gives at least one unit for the supply days, the allowed amounts on those remittances divided by the units that allowance gives; on a tier whose notice form is the plan member waiver, the billed charge per unit less 10 percent; and otherwise the billed charge per unit, the billed charge per unit being the billed charge on the denied claim divided by the shipment's units, and 0 when the shipment records no units.

- The remittances counted are those posted against the denied claim.

| Tier's notice form | Tiers using it | Price of a unit |
|---|---|---|
| CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice, remittances against the claim with allowed amounts totalling more than 0, and at least one allowance unit | Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | total allowed amount divided by the allowance units |
| plan member waiver | Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program, Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | billed charge per unit less 10 percent |
| any other case | for example Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | billed charge per unit |

**Worked prices (hypothetical claims)**

- Billed 120.00 for 6 units on a plan member waiver tier: 20.00 per unit less 10 percent, that is 18.00.
- Advance Beneficiary Notice tier, remittance allowed amount 37.00, allowance units 2: 18.50 per unit.
- Advance Beneficiary Notice tier with no remittance posted against the denied claim, or with remittances whose allowed amounts total 0: 20.00 per unit, the billed charge per unit.
- A shipment that records no units: a billed charge per unit of 0.
